## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally (gofmt, go vet, `go test -timeout 120s ./...`)
- [ ] I added/updated tests for my change
- [ ] I updated documentation where relevant (`README.md`, `docs/`, `AGENTS.md`)
- [ ] Secrets are never committed; `sources.yaml` stores only env-var names
